title: Strongly enstrophy-stable integrators for the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations
summary: We propose a mixed finite element discretisation for the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations that preserves the evolution laws of both energy and enstrophy, in a stronger sense than previous discretisations. In two dimensions, the evolution law for enstrophy only permits dissipation for thermodynamically isolated systems, leading to a Reynolds-number-independent bound on the velocity gradient that naturally stabilises the scheme, even on severely under-resolved meshes.
